# PDF browser assets

- jsPDF 4.2.1: vendored from the pinned npm package `jspdf/dist/jspdf.umd.min.js`, license-comment trailing whitespace normalized; MIT license in `jsPDF-LICENSE.txt`.
- Amiri Regular and Bold: Google Fonts `ofl/amiri/Amiri-Regular.ttf` and `Amiri-Bold.ttf`, retrieved 2026-09-08 from https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/amiri, SIL Open Font License in `OFL.txt`.

All PDF code and fonts are served from this application. PDF creation takes place locally in the browser and does not send CV contents to an external converter.
